payload.message: Run the daily profile movement report. Query Athena (workgroup: clio-agent, region: us-west-2) for: 1) PAID CHURNS in last 24h — separate B2B (muso_team_business_*) and B2P (muso_team_pro_* + muso_individual_*), include emails. 2) PAID JOINS in last 24h ranked by popularity. 3) POPULAR LITE USERS — claimed profiles with popularity 90+ and no paid subscription. jobs.name: daily-pr-review
jobs.description: Daily production risk review of merged PRs

payload.message: Daily PR Code Review. Review all PRs merged in the last 24 hours across Muso-AI repos (core-backend, platform-data-processing, industry-data-processing, analytics-worker, web-credits, mobile) for PRODUCTION RISK. For each merged PR fetch the diff. Analyze for: OOM, scaling, concurrency, data integrity, error handling, performance risks. Post results with risk ratings. Focus on real problems at production scale, not style nits.

jobs.name: nightly-slack-clickup-gap-analysis

jobs.name: daily-dev-activity-report
jobs.description: Daily developer activity report — commits, features, bugs fixed across all repos

payload.message: Run the daily dev activity report. For each developer (adk47=Aaron, liflovs=Serhii), run the dev-report.sh script or use gh CLI to get commits from the last 24h across all Muso-AI repos (core-backend, web-credits, platform-data-processing, industry-data-processing, analytics-worker, mobile, devops, feed-service, customer-api-mcp, render-service, web-encore). Format for Slack mrkdwn (no tables, bullets only). Post each dev report as a separate message. If zero commits, say so briefly.
